objections.claim: Mandating an external message broker for synchronous task CRUD introduces unnecessary operational moving parts and distributed consensus overhead.
objections.failure_scenario: If every task status update requires Pub/Sub ack roundtrips before responding to the user, write latency spikes and failure modes multiply.
objections.recommended_mitigation: Execute core task CRUD transactionally in the datastore, using asynchronous Pub/Sub only for out-of-band notification events and audit streaming.

objections.claim: Complex microservice decomposition across dozens of micro-containers creates orchestration sprawl for a modular Flask application.
objections.failure_scenario: Managing separate containers for each minor capability complicates local development and CI/CD pipelines.
objections.recommended_mitigation: Deploy cohesive subsystems (task_service and audit_service) with clear domain boundaries within a single clean architecture service repository.
